title: John G NDE 9177
content: My cousins and I were in a hay barn in the attic. We were running around in circles when I fell 15 feet through a hole. I landed flat on my back and onto the concrete floor. My cousins said it all happened in a matter of seconds, but to me, it felt like a half hour. I recall floating above myself right after I landed. I could see myself lying there. Then, it was SUPER bright with clouds. Then, it got dark and I woke up. I could stand up perfectly but it felt like I weighed a million pounds. I could barely walk. I vividly remember seeing myself from up above my body. It was peaceful, no sound, and filled with blindingly, bright light. Thank you. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 05/01/2001 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Out of body experience when I fell 15 feet on my back onto a concrete slab. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was floating above my body and rising. I could vividly see myself lying there. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. It all happened in seconds Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was CRYSTAL clear. I could vividly see my body lying there Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was no sounds during my experience Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was a blinding light Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. It was super bright and a sky-like environment above the clouds. It was so bright, it’s hard to say if it was an unearthly world. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peacefulness, weightless Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It all happened so fast. I can’t remember if the entire experience lasted hours in perceived time, or if it was seconds. It happened so fast How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real. Because I perceived it was real. I experienced it, and I saw what I saw. There’s no way to back it up What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was probably real Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes

environment.environment_other_detail: “SUPER bright with clouds” and “a sky-like environment above the clouds.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell ~15 feet through a hole in a hay barn attic, landed on back on a concrete floor/slab.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness occurred (“Then, it got dark and I woke up.”).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE immediately after impact, then super bright/clouds, then darkness and waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived duration mismatch: cousins said seconds, but it felt like “a half hour.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I recall floating above myself right after I landed. I could see myself lying there.” / “It was peaceful, no sound, and filled with blindingly, bright light.” / “Then, it was SUPER bright with clouds. Then, it got dark and I woke up.”
